newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS MOSTLY FIRMER AS MARKET CORRECTS.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS MOSTLY FIRMER AS MARKET CORRECTS.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were firmer on Thursday, paring some of Wednesday's losses.
September, which led the market down on Wednesday, edged back towards the nine pence a therm mark, and was last traded at 8.890 pence at 1120 GMT. A total of 290 lots had traded.
"September has recovered a bit. It doesn't look like it wants to go much lower," said one trader.
In the fourth quarter, which fell heavily on the spot market on Wednesday, October traded 0.050 penny higher at 10.70 pence and December gained 0.10 pence to 15.30 pence.
Further out, activity was seen in the second quarter of 1998. May was the highest climber on the board gaining 0.210 to 11.10 pence, while June slipped lower, shedding 0.250 penny to 10.40 pence.
